propositions: No Jira Data Center license or official OpenAPI spec is available, so a DC adapter is unverifiable except against a real Jira instance used as an oracle.

A vendored Dockerfile must BUILD a real Jira 8.17.1 instance from the addono base pinned by digest (not pull an unpublished pycontribs image), exercising PAT bearer auth over REST v2 at http://localhost:2990/jira.

The entrypoint must keep -DskipAllPrompts=true (retired Marketplace v1 endpoint) and -Dproduct.start.timeout (Cargo's default 600000ms ceiling kills the container ~25 min in under slow/emulated boot); -DstartupTimeout and -Dcargo.timeout have no effect.

The harness lives under tests/external/ where it inherits opt-in gating (REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1), the _live_jira_ready all-skip canary, and must SKIP (not fail) with an actionable message when the instance is absent to avoid breaking the no-Docker external CI job.

Teardown asserts each issue's direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint returns 404 (index-independent per ADR 0037 §3), never consulting search, and the compose port binds loopback-only to avoid exposing admin/admin credentials.

Acceptance evidence requires a native amd64 runner because arm64 emulation cannot boot the instance within the timeout; a new dedicated external-integration.yml job builds, waits, runs only the harness tests, and tears down under if: always().
